text: I was charged twice. Please refund the duplicate payment.
annotation_note: Explicit money-back request; mild complaint.

text: I do not want a refund. Please correct the name on my invoice.
annotation_note: Negation overrides the mention of refund.

text: The app crashes when I export a report. This is annoying.
annotation_note: Bug report with mild annoyance.

text: Please reset my password. I forgot it.
annotation_note: Routine credential management.

text: What are your support hours this weekend?
annotation_note: General information outside the three specialist teams.

text: I cannot log in and my card was charged twice. I am frustrated; please fix both.
annotation_note: Two teams needed; first actionable issue is the reference tie-break.

text: Third request: the export STILL fails. This is unacceptable and I am furious.
annotation_note: Explicit intense anger; no money-back request.

text: Please cancel my subscription at renewal. No refund is necessary.
annotation_note: Subscription administration belongs to billing.

text: How do I change the email address on my account?
annotation_note: Profile management.

text: This is not working. I am very frustrated.
annotation_note: Insufficient detail to choose a specialist.

text: Can you explain the refund policy before I buy?
annotation_note: Policy question is not a refund request.

text: I love the new dashboard; could you add a dark theme?
annotation_note: Feature suggestion, not a reported malfunction.

text: You billed me after cancellation. I am very frustrated. Please return that payment.
annotation_note: Return payment is an explicit refund request.

text: The payment is fine. My problem is that the download button does nothing.
annotation_note: Payment is explicitly not the problem.

text: Could you help me invite a colleague to our account?
annotation_note: Membership administration.

text: Help! Something went wrong.
annotation_note: No identifiable product area; urgency does not prove anger.

text: Our whole team is blocked by server errors. I am furious that this keeps happening.
annotation_note: Technical outage with explicit intense frustration.

text: Could you send a copy of last month's invoice?
annotation_note: Routine billing document request.

text: Do not reverse the charge. Please just change my billing address.
annotation_note: Explicitly declines money back.

text: Wonderful, another crash. Exactly what I needed today.
annotation_note: Sarcasm makes frustration annotation contestable.

text: Do you offer an education discount?
annotation_note: Pre-purchase sales question; not an existing invoice.

text: Please refund the extra charge and reset my password.
annotation_note: Mixed intent; first actionable issue determines reference team.

text: I am very frustrated. I am locked out even after resetting my password.
annotation_note: Access problem, even if a software bug could be its root cause.

text: It would be helpful to have keyboard shortcuts for the editor.
annotation_note: Feature suggestion without frustration.
